svg.text: TRAIN lexicon → frozen CLIP text embeddings
Mask: only endpoints s or o
Unmatched prompts are omitted; an empty mask gives zero residual.
TRAIN references only • no object-reward loss
Frozen: CLIP encoders, semantic banks and detectors. Learned: CSA, prompt adapters and decoder. N = valid ROIs; d = 512.
D and C are normalized within the candidate set; O is normalized detector-based object consistency. No reference captions are used for reranking.
